cases.reference_query: MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub, count(cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub, crCnt, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC WITH hub, crCnt, collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub, crCnt, count(s) AS secCnt RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCnt, secCnt, round(1.0 * crCnt / secCnt, 2) AS density ORDER BY density DESC

cases.reference_query:
MATCH (sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291']
WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS ts
OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(crTarget:Spec)
WHERE crTarget.specNumber = ts
WITH ts, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt
OPTIONAL MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr2:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(agrTarget:Spec)
WHERE agrTarget.specNumber = ts
RETURN ts, crCnt, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCnt
ORDER BY crCnt DESC, ts ASC
